appearances.snippet: He was actually the founder. ... alongside his brother Arnaud Brunel, of a modeling agency in New York City, one called Next Model Management. ... Jean-Luc Brunel and his brother founded the Next Model Corporation. And from that spun the next model management modeling agency.

verification.notes: New York corporate records reported by reliable outlets identify Jean-Luc and Arnaud Brunel as founders of Next Management Corporation in 1988. In 1989 the Brunels participated with Faith Kates in forming Next Model Management, in which the brothers held a minority interest. This supports the stated corporate sequence, while later company histories emphasize Kates and Joel Wilkenfeld as the enduring founders.
